value.rationale: The formula is an exact resource invariant for every mixed-parity rectangular Hamming stabilizer network in the specified model, without finite cutoffs, and captures interacting idempotent/nilpotent binary sectors that the known homogeneous rank formulas do not cover as quantified statements. It answers a natural graph-state design question and specifies sharp orientation-independent ancilla costs, not merely a routine numeric recomputation.
